portal_hypertension.title: Umbilical vein recanalization identified on contrast-enhanced ultrasound in a patient with hepatocellular carcinoma during TACE assessment.
portal_hypertension.authors: KuonYeng-Escalante C, Liu JB, Xu J
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于病例研究。核心观点：我们描述了一位 62 岁的女性，她有代谢功能障碍相关的脂肪肝病史，并出现腹痛。 临床提示：本病例报告展示了对比增强超声作为先前在横截面成像中看到的血管异常发现的支持工具的潜在用途。
portal_hypertension.abstract: This case report demonstrates the potential use of contrast-enhanced ultrasound as a support tool for vascular abnormality findings previously seen on cross-sectional imaging. We describe a 62-year-old woman with history of metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease who presented abdominal pain. Ultrasound demonstrated cirrhosis and indeterminate liver lesions. With these findings, contrast-enhanced magnetic resonance imaging was performed and 2 LI-RADS 5 lesions < 3 cm and vascular changes consistent with portal hypertension were observed. portal_hypertension.title: Portopulmonary Hypertension: Current Perspectives.
portal_hypertension.authors: John T, Stauber RE, Douschan P
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于综述研究。核心观点：这是一种严重的并发症，影响约 5% 的肝硬化患者。 临床提示：门脉性肺动脉高压（PoPH）是肝硬化或非肝硬化门脉高压情况下肺动脉高压的一种形式。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Portopulmonary hypertension (PoPH) is a form of pulmonary arterial hypertension in the setting of cirrhotic or noncirrhotic portal hypertension. It is a significant complication affecting approximately 5% of patients with cirrhosis. PoPH contributes to morbidity and mortality of chronic liver disease by significantly increasing right cardiac afterload, ultimately leading to right heart failure and complicating disease management. We review the current literature of PoPH pathophysiology with special focus on cardiopulmonary hemodynamics, clinical presentation, diagnostic challenges, and management strategies. A central illustration should visually capture the summarized information.

portal_hypertension.title: Liver Transplant Outcomes in Patients With Transjugular Intrahepatic Portosystemic Shunt: A Retrospective Cohort Study With Propensity Score Analysis.
portal_hypertension.journal: Journal of clinical and experimental hepatology
portal_hypertension.authors: Biolato M, Lai Q, Galasso T
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究（样本量约为 263）。核心观点：经颈静脉肝内门体分流术（TIPS）用于治疗等待肝移植的患者的门静脉高压相关并发症。 临床提示：然而，移植前 TIPS 放置的作用仍然存在争议。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Transjugular intrahepatic portosystemic shunt (TIPS) is used to manage portal hypertension-related complications in patients awaiting liver transplantation. However, the role of pretransplant TIPS placement remains controversial. We conducted a retrospective, single-center cohort study to evaluate the impact of pretransplant TIPS on postoperative complications and in-hospital mortality. We included 263 cirrhotic patients who underwent liver transplantation from deceased donors between 2015 and 2023. Twenty-three patients (8.7%) underwent pretransplant TIPS placement. portal_hypertension.title: Clip-Assisted Cyanoacrylate Injection for the Management of a Proximal Colonic Varix.
portal_hypertension.journal: Journal of clinical and experimental hepatology
portal_hypertension.authors: Giri S, Maheswari S, Praharaj DL
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究。核心观点：结肠静脉曲张是门静脉高压症的罕见表现，也是下消化道出血的罕见原因，尤其是累及近端结肠时。 临床提示：我们报告了一例肝曲静脉曲张出血的病例，患者为一名 23 岁男性，患有肝外门静脉阻塞 (EHPVO)，之前接受过脾切除术和脾肾分流术。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Colonic varices are a rare manifestation of portal hypertension and an uncommon cause of lower gastrointestinal bleeding, particularly when involving the proximal colon. We report a case of bleeding hepatic flexure varices in a 23-year-old male with extrahepatic portal vein obstruction (EHPVO) and prior splenectomy with lienorenal shunt. The patient presented with recurrent hematochezia and severe anemia. Upper gastrointestinal endoscopy was negative for a bleeding source, while colonoscopy revealed large tortuous varices at the hepatic flexure with stigmata of recent hemorrhage. portal_hypertension.title: Transmesenteric Extrahepatic Portosystemic Shunt for Cavernous Transformation of Portal Vein with Superior Mesenteric Vein Occlusion.
portal_hypertension.authors: Li W, Zhang H, Mu K
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究。核心观点：评价经肠系膜肝外门体分流术治疗门静脉海绵样变性肠系膜上静脉闭塞患者的可行性、安全性和临床疗效。 临床提示：连续 21 例患者接受了经肠系膜肝外门体分流术，其中男性 13 例（62%），中位年龄 50 岁（四分位数范围，43.5-56.5 岁）。
portal_hypertension.abstract: To evaluate the feasibility, safety, and clinical efficacy of transmesenteric extrahepatic portosystemic shunt in patients with cavernous transformation of the portal vein complicated by superior mesenteric vein occlusion. Twenty-one consecutive patients underwent transmesenteric extrahepatic portosystemic shunt, including 13 men (62%), with a median age of 50 years (interquartile range, 43.5-56.5 years). As a hybrid procedure, the superior mesenteric vein was accessed through a mini-laparotomy and recanalized when feasible.
